# BurstSuppressionMechanism

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A regulatory process that limits burst duration or frequency to prevent runaway excitation and maintain network stability. Essential for reliable operation of large-scale spiking networks in resource-constrained in-network neuromorphic hardware.
